provenance.derivation: Scalars and resampled contours only; original g-files and psi grids are excluded.
provenance.distributionPolicy: Public artifact is visualization-derived data. Raw experimental files are not distributed.

coordinateSystem.cadRegistration: Apply a separately versioned T_CAD_FROM_EFIT; no unverified transform is baked in.

binaryLayout.contourCoordinates: interleaved Float32 [R0,Z0,...], counter-clockwise, equal-arc-length, phase starts near max R
binaryLayout.missingContour: all coordinates are finite zeroes and the corresponding valid bit is zero; never render them or interpolate fabricated source frames

derivation.description: Axisymmetric EFIT saddle points and observed psi=psi_X branches; no raw psi grid is distributed.
derivation.separatrixLegs: Primary X points only; numerical trace follows the active boundary psiN=1 (psi=psi_boundary) and is equal-arc-length resampled to 64 points. Secondary X points are marker-only.
derivation.strikePoints: Exact separatrix-segment intersection with the supplied limiter polyline only; no extrapolation. This is a limiter-intersection proxy, not a verified divertor-target registration.
derivation.uncertainty: Spatial claims below half a source-grid diagonal are unsupported; secondary X points are near-null evidence, not an active separatrix.
derivation.strictDoubleNullPolicy: Not granted for this release: each frame has one conservative primary X point. The double-null code is reserved for a future reviewed dRsep or equivalent engineering criterion.

binaryLayout.baseBinding: File header bytes 48..63 contain the first 16 raw bytes of the base EXL50EF1 SHA-256; the full digest is in shot.topologyBinary.baseBinarySha256.
binaryLayout.payload: From byte 160: four zero-filled slots of 64 interleaved Float32 [R,Z] points; render only legValidPoints > 0.
